description: The plot illustrates the relative change across different neural network layer groups for various configurations of token multipliers and bit precisions, evaluated on LB-Avg and RULER4k metrics alongside a baseline. The x-axis represents categorical layer groups, with discrete tick labels for "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32". The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" and uses a linear scale ranging from -25% to 5%, with tick marks at 10% intervals (-25%, -15%, -5%, 5%) and an additional reference line at 0%. Five lines are displayed on the plot. The "Baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit" is represented by a grey dashed line without markers, remaining constant at 0% across all layer groups. The "LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit" is shown as a solid gold line with circular markers; it starts near 0% at Layer1-4, experiences a slight dip to approximately -1.5% at Layer13-20, and ends slightly above 0% at Layer29-32. The "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit" is depicted by a solid red line with square markers, starting at 0% at Layer1-4, reaching a low of roughly -4.5% at Layer13-20, and recovering to approximately -0.5% at Layer29-32. The "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit" is a solid teal line with circular markers, beginning at approximately -1.5% at Layer1-4, dropping to a minimum of about -12.5% at Layer13-20, and returning to roughly -1.5% at Layer29-32. Finally, the "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit" is represented by a solid dark blue line with square markers, starting at approximately -2.5% at Layer1-4, experiencing a sharp decline to exactly -25% at Layer13-20, and ending at roughly -3% at Layer29-32.
